title: [Articles] Status, challenges, and future directions of machine learning in the management of epilepsy: a systematic review and meta-analysis
zh_title: 机器学习用于癫痫管理的系统综述与meta分析
summary: 该系统综述与meta分析评估机器学习预测癫痫治疗结局的表现，指出异质性与偏倚限制其临床可用性。
abstract: Although machine learning shows promise in predicting epilepsy treatment outcomes, the high heterogeneity and bias—particularly in small sample sizes, handling of missing data, and scarcity of studies with external validation—limit its clinical applicability. Future research should focus on larger, diverse datasets and standardised minimum reporting. Prospective trials are needed to evaluate machine learning models in real-world settings.

title: Noise2Match: Self-Supervised Low-Dose CT Denoising via Adaptive Inter-Slice Matching.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: Noise2Match：自适应层间匹配的自监督低剂量CT去噪
summary: 提出利用相邻CT切片相似性并处理非刚性错位的自监督低剂量CT去噪方法，无需配对干净数据。
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] With the rapid development of deep learning, supervised convolutional neural network methods have greatly improved the performance of low-dose computed tomography (CT) denoising. However, they require paired noisy-clean training data, which is difficult to obtain in practice. Some classic self-supervised denoising methods rely on the assumption of pixel-wise independent noise, making them ineffective for correlated noise in low-dose CT (LDCT) images. Considering the high similarity and weaker noise correlation between adjacent CT slices, several recently proposed self-supervised methods use adjacent LDCT slices for training. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to effectively account for the non-rigid mis-alignment between slices caused by anatomical variation, hindering them from satisfying the equal-mean condition required by the classic Noise2Noise framework. In this paper, we propose Noise2Match, a self-supervised LDCT denoising method based on adaptive inter-slice matching. Noise2Match introduces an inter-slice matching network to model the label transition process between adjacent slices, and then applies correction to the denoiser's outputs to better satisfy the equal-mean condition. We theoretically prove that, under idealized conditions, training Noise2Match using adjacent LDCT slices is equivalent to supervised training with paired noisy-clean images. We further find that Noise2Match can also effectively perform low-dose cone-beam CT (CBCT) denoising, which could be attributed to its correction operation that reduces inter-slice noise correlation. To the best of our knowledge, Noise2Match is the first effective image-domain self-supervised method for low-dose CBCT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Noise2Match outperforms existing image-domain self-supervised methods, offering broader applicability and higher practical value.
key_points: 监督CNN去噪依赖难以获取的配对数据
经典自监督法假设噪声像素独立，不适用LDCT
针对切片间非刚性错位设计自适应匹配
reason: 方法有新意且发表于同行评审期刊，但摘要未体现外部验证或公开数据
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 随着深度学习的快速发展，监督式卷积神经网络方法已大幅提升低剂量计算机断层扫描（CT）去噪的性能。然而，这些方法需要配对的噪声-干净训练数据，而这在实际中难以获得。一些经典自监督去噪方法依赖于逐像素独立噪声的假设，使其对低剂量CT（LDCT）图像中的相关噪声无效。考虑到相邻CT层面之间的高度相似性和较弱噪声相关性，近期提出的若干自监督方法使用相邻LDCT层面进行训练。然而，这些方法未能有效考虑由解剖变异引起的层面间非刚性错位，阻碍其满足经典Noise2Noise框架所要求的等均值条件。本文提出Noise2Match，一种基于自适应层面间匹配的自监督LDCT去噪方法。Noise2Match引入层面间匹配网络来建模相邻层面之间的标签转移过程，然后对去噪器输出施加校正，以更好地满足等均值条件。我们从理论上证明，在理想化条件下，使用相邻LDCT层面训练Noise2Match等效于使用配对噪声-干净图像进行监督训练。我们进一步发现，Noise2Match也能有效执行低剂量锥形束CT（CBCT）去噪，这可能归因于其减少层面间噪声相关性的校正操作。据我们所知，Noise2Match是首个用于低剂量CBCT的有效图像域自监督方法。大量实验表明，Noise2Match优于现有图像域自监督方法，具有更广泛的适用性和更高的实用价值。

abstract: In modern cancer research, the vast volume of medical data generated is often underutilised due to challenges related to patient privacy. The OncoReg Challenge addresses this issue by enabling researchers to develop and validate image registration methods through a two-phase framework that ensures patient privacy while fostering the development of more generalisable AI models. Phase one involves working with a publicly available dataset, while phase two focuses on training models on a private dataset within secure hospital networks. OncoReg builds upon the foundation established by the Learn2Reg Challenge by incorporating the registration of interventional cone-beam computed tomography with standard planning fan-beam CT images in radiotherapy. title: Pre-Treatment Breast DCE-MRI AI Model to Predict Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Benefit in Locally Advanced Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
zh_title: 乳腺癌DCE-MRI AI预测新辅助化疗获益的前瞻多中心研究
summary: 福建肿瘤医院发起的多中心前瞻观察性研究，计划入组120例局部晚期三阴性乳腺癌，评估治疗前DCE-MRI的AI模型预测新辅助化疗获益的表现。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fujian Cancer Hospital; conditions: Breast Neoplasm Female, Triple -Negative Breast Cancer; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 120; status: RECRUITING] This study is a multicenter, prospective, observational cohort study to evaluate the predictive performance of pre-treatment DCE-MRI-based artificial intelligence (AI) models for neoadjuvant chemotherapy benefit in locally advanced triple-negative breast cancer. The study plans to enroll eligible locally advanced triple-negative breast cancer patients receiving routine standard neoadjuvant chemotherapy and stratify participants into high-benefit and low-benefit subgroups via the established AI model based on baseline breast DCE-MRI images. All enrolled patients will undergo systematic collection of baseline clinical-pathological data, pre-treatment DCE-MRI scans, neoadjuvant chemotherapy regimens, pathological complete response (pCR) status, objective response rate (ORR), and long-term survival endpoints including disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS). The primary objective compares the pCR rate between AI-defined high-benefit patients and published historical control data; secondary analyses compare ORR, pCR proportion, DFS and OS between AI-stratified high-benefit and low-benefit subgroups to comprehensively verify the clinical value of this imaging AI model for individualized neoadjuvant chemotherapy selection.

title: Beyond the Scribe: Using Nominal Group Technique to Co-Design an Evaluation Framework for Patient-Held AI
zh_title: 用名义群体技术共建患者端AI评价框架
summary: medRxiv预印本，与大型科技公司合作，用名义群体技术共同设计患者持有的AI个人健康助手在真实场景中的评价框架。
abstract: The explosive growth of ambient AI scribes in healthcare has focused almost exclusively on relieving clinician documentation burdens and enhancing clinician efficiency and reducing burnout. While most research has focused on the clinician experience, these same types of tools, such as a patient held AI Personal Health Assistant, can be put in the hands of patients to facilitate communication with healthcare providers, to provide greater autonomy and activation for patients in managing their own healthcare, and to facilitate the task of receiving and retaining complex new information. However, to ensure these tools serve as more than just administrative aids, we partnered with a large technology company to conceptually codesign how such a tool might be studied in real world settings in a way that reflected outcomes of greatest importance to patients and families. We used the Nominal Group Technique and engaged thirty three patients and caregivers and ten multidisciplinary clinicians in structured virtual sessions to identify the outcomes on which subsequent studies should hinge. Our findings reveal a significant misalignment between current industry trends and patient priorities. While the market emphasizes the scribe function for billing, stakeholders overwhelmingly prioritized the AIPHAs role in longitudinal care management and post visit coordination. The most critical outcome identified was the impact on communication and respect, suggesting that patients view AI as a mechanism to improve the human to human dynamic and ensure a shared understanding of the care plan. Our findings further highlighted that the primary hurdle for the use of patient held AI is not technical utility but clinician trust and the need for formal consent processes. Importantly, as this technology is new and integration into the clinical experience is still being explored, patients cannot assume they will have access to the transcript of their own encounter when that record is created and held by the health system. This gap highlights the potential value of a patient held tool, preserving discussions from their visit and follow up steps in clearer detail than they may receive in their clinical note or traditional visit summary. From a system perspective, this transition requires a strategic shift from measuring workflow focused efficiency to measuring patient side advocacy and engagement. zh_abstract: 医疗领域中环境式AI记录工具（ambient AI scribes）的爆发式增长几乎只关注减轻临床医生文书负担、提高临床医生效率并减少职业倦怠。虽然大多数研究聚焦于临床医生体验，但同类工具，例如患者持有的AI个人健康助理（AI Personal Health Assistant，AIPHA），可以交到患者手中，以促进与医疗服务提供者的沟通，为患者管理自身医疗提供更大的自主权和激活度，并帮助患者接收和记住复杂的新信息。然而，为确保这些工具不仅仅作为行政辅助工具发挥作用，我们与一家大型科技公司合作，从概念上共同设计如何在真实世界环境中研究此类工具，使其反映对患者和家庭最重要的结局。我们采用名义群体技术（Nominal Group Technique），让33名患者和照护者以及10名多学科临床医生参与结构化虚拟会议，以确定后续研究应围绕的结局指标。我们的发现揭示了当前行业趋势与患者优先事项之间的显著错位。市场强调用于计费的记录功能，而利益相关者绝大多数优先考虑AIPHA在纵向照护管理和就诊后协调中的作用。所确定的最关键结局是对沟通和尊重的影响，这表明患者将AI视为改善人与人之间互动并确保对诊疗计划形成共同理解的机制。我们的发现进一步强调，使用患者持有的AI的主要障碍不是技术效用，而是临床医生信任以及正式知情同意流程的需求。重要的是，由于该技术尚新且融入临床体验的方式仍在探索中，当记录由卫生系统创建并持有时，患者不能假定自己能够获取其自身就诊的转录文本。这一差距凸显了患者持有工具的潜在价值，它能以比患者从临床记录或传统就诊摘要中可能获得的更清晰细节，保存其就诊讨论和随访步骤。从系统角度看，这一转变要求战略重心从衡量以工作流程为中心的效率转向衡量患者侧的倡导和参与。通过将AI评估集中于这些由患者定义的指标，并从根本上设计
